Package game.items.tools

Interface Enchantable

All Known Implementing Classes:
AbstractEnchantableTool, Hoe, Pickaxe, WateringCan
public interface Enchantable
Capability interface for Items that can carry an Enchantment and trigger it the next time they are used for their ordinary purpose. Implementing classes own their own storage (typically by composing an EnchantmentSlot) and combine the Enchantment's effect with their own, independent tool-specific effect.

      void enchant(Enchantment enchantment)

    • triggerEnchantment

      String triggerEnchantment(Actor actor, Location location)
      While this tool is enchanted, applies this tool's own effect and fires its attached Enchantment against the tiles that effect touched, then consumes the Enchantment. Does nothing while unenchanted.
      Parameters:
      actor - the Actor using the tool
      location - the Location the tool was used at
      Returns:
      a description of what fired, or "" while unenchanted; never null
